nodes.description: MANAGER_ROLE: bytes32 public constant role identifier (keccak256 of MANAGER_ROLE) used by the onlyRole modifier to guard withdraw.
DinoEggs constructor: mints 3,000,000 ether of tokens to the contract itself and grants DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE to _msgSender().
withdraw(address,uint256) external, restricted by onlyRole(MANAGER_ROLE); checks the contract balance and transfers eggs to the recipient.
msg.sender accessed via _msgSender(): used as the DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE grantee in the constructor and as the caller checked by onlyRole in withdraw.
_transfer(address(this), _address, _amount): internal token balance mutation and Transfer event emitted from the withdraw path.
_mint(address(this), 3000000 ether): initial supply creation performed inside the constructor.
_grantRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, _msgSender()): privileged role assignment performed inside the constructor.
_address: recipient parameter of withdraw, forwarded to _transfer.
_amount: amount parameter of withdraw, validated against the contract balance and forwarded to _transfer.

edges.reason: withdraw is gated by the onlyRole(MANAGER_ROLE) modifier, so the MANAGER_ROLE state variable controls access to the function.
The caller (msg.sender via _msgSender) is the account whose role membership is verified by the access-control modifier before withdraw executes.
The constructor grants DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE to _msgSender(), delegating privileged authority to the deployer address.
The constructor invokes _mint to create the initial token supply for the contract itself.
The constructor invokes _grantRole to assign the default admin role.
The _address parameter flows into the _transfer recipient argument of the withdraw path.
The _amount parameter flows into the _transfer value argument of the withdraw path.
withdraw calls _transfer after the balance requirement check, executing the state-mutating token transfer.

normalization_plan.reason: The _address parameter has no independent behavior; it only supplies the recipient argument to the internal _transfer call in withdraw.
The _amount parameter has no independent behavior; it is bounds-checked against balanceOf(address(this)) and then supplies the value argument to _transfer.
